$comment: Written by test/golden/skills/capture.ts (W1 R7 P9 t2; review round 1, P9-R1-17). What the three skill scripts did on each fixture case, captured on a maintainer machine. CI never runs Python. capture.ts --check compares every field except provenance.

provenance.$comment: What made the goldens. Not compared by --check: it differs between machines and fresh installs.
provenance.openpyxl_note: The openpyxl and et_xmlfile versions, from a throwaway virtual environment under the temporary folder; never committed.
provenance.wheels_note: The SHA-256 of each wheel file installed into that environment, as PyPI publishes it (given with --wheel).

normalizations.N1: The project folder path (as given and as resolved) becomes <root>; in BuildOS output on Windows, \ after <root> becomes /.
normalizations.N2: A Python traceback keeps its last line only, so no machine path or line number is kept.
normalizations.N3: A written .xlsx is recorded by its SHA-256 and kept in <script>/xlsx/; the parity test compares workbook content, not bytes (parity exception PE-021).
normalizations.N4: The clock is fixed at 2026-01-15T12:00:00Z for the script (a runner that replaces datetime.datetime.now for work.py and datetime.date.today for fitgap.py) and for BuildOS (RunOptions.now).
